note: The candidate ISO-8601 string bytes are read to compute the parser length and locate the date/time separator.
The substring after the separator is passed as the time and timezone field controlled by the input.
The offset suffix extent is derived from the last sign character without independently requiring that the remaining time portion has a valid bounded layout.
The parser indexes into the candidate-controlled suffix while classifying the timezone form, which is the hypothesized out-of-bounds read site.
